decision.explanation: Each of these four names refers to the first owner of a distinct historic house called the 'Short House' in different documents. Document D1S6 identifies George Washington Short as the first owner of the George Short House in Greenville, KY. Document D3S3 identifies Thomas Jefferson Long as the first owner of another Short House in the same area. Document D4S6 identifies John Adams Long as the first owner of yet another Short House in the same general location. Document D5S1–S3 and D5S4–S5 identify William A. Short and Sally Baker Short as the original owners of the Short House in Helena, AR. These are distinct referents and valid answers based on the provided sources.
